10. (a) State what is meant by recursion. [1]
(b) Consider the following recursive sub-program:
recur(N)
output (N)
if N > 0 then
recur (N-1)
output (N)
end if
end recur
and the following sub-program call:
recur(NUMBER)
where is an integer.
NUMBER
(i) State the number of times the output statement will be executed if is
NUMBER
smaller than or equal to zero. [1]
(ii) State the number of times the output statement will be executed if is
NUMBER
greater than zero. [1]
